name: com.thebonusstack/bonuses
title: The Bonus Stack
description: Current US bank account bonuses: amounts, requirements, deadlines and direct deposit reports.

tools.name: find_bonuses
tools.description: Find current US bank account bonuses a person can get: cash a bank pays for opening a checking, savings or fintech account and meeting its requirements. Use this for questions like 'what bank bonuses can I get in Ohio', 'bonuses that need no direct deposit', 'best checking bonus with no monthly fee' or 'savings bonuses ending soon'. Always pass the person's state when you know it, because many offers are limited to certain states. Returns up to 10 offers in The Bonus Stack's own order, each with the amount, the main requirement, the deadline, the date we last verified it, a link to its page and an apply link. For the full terms of one offer, call get_bonus.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, such as OH or TX.

account_type.description: Account type. portal lists cashback portal routes, which the other types leave out. With direct_deposit not_required the list is the no-direct-deposit page's own, which includes the portal options it shows.

direct_deposit.description: not_required lists only bonuses a person can earn without a direct deposit.

filters.description: Narrow the list. Every filter named must hold.

search.description: Bank, account or requirement words, matched the way the search box on thebonusstack.com/bonuses matches them.

sort.description: best is easiest first, then the larger amount. ending_soon puts the nearest deadline first.

limit.description: How many offers to return, 1 to 10.

tools.name: get_bonus
tools.description: Get the full details of one bank bonus: every requirement step, the bonus amount or tiers, the deadline, the fees and how to avoid them, who is eligible and in which states, whether the bank does a hard credit pull, when the bonus is paid, and the apply link. Use it after find_bonuses, or when a person names a bank or an account, such as 'the Chase Total Checking bonus' or 'is the SoFi bonus still live'. Pass bonus_id from find_bonuses, or a bank or account name.

name.description: A bank or account name, such as Chase Total Checking or SoFi, when there is no bonus_id.

state.description: The person's state, to add the conditions that apply there.

tools.name: check_direct_deposit
tools.description: Check which transfers a bank counts as a direct deposit for its bonus, from community reports. Use it for questions like 'does Zelle count as direct deposit at Chase', 'what triggers the direct deposit requirement at SoFi' or 'can I use a transfer from Fidelity instead of a paycheck'. Pass the bank, and the transfer source if the person named one. Returns each reported source with whether recent reports say it worked, how many reports there are and the newest report date. These are other people's reports, not the bank's promise.

bank.description: The bank's name, such as Chase, SoFi or Wells Fargo.

transfer_source.description: The transfer the person asked about, such as Zelle, Fidelity, Venmo or a paycheck.

tools.name: get_payout_timeline
tools.description: See how long a bank takes to pay a bonus after the account is opened, from community reports and the offer's own terms. Use it for 'how long until Chase pays the bonus' or 'when will my Wells Fargo bonus post'.

bank.description: The bank's name, such as Chase or Wells Fargo.

tools.name: whats_changed
tools.description: List bank bonuses that were added, raised, extended or ended recently, and bonuses ending soon. Use it for 'any new bank bonuses this week', 'what changed since I last checked' or 'which bonuses end this month'. Covers the last 90 days.

since.description: The first day to list, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago; no earlier than 90 days ago.

kinds.description: Which changes to list. ending_soon lists bonuses whose deadline falls in the next 45 days. Defaults to all.

state.description: The person's state, to list only bonuses open there.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Find The Bonus Stack's plain-English guides: what counts as a direct deposit, whether bank bonuses are taxed, how ChexSystems works, how long to keep an account open, and each bank's direct deposit guide. Use it for how-to questions and for 'is it taxed' or 'will it hurt my credit' questions that are not about one specific offer.

query.description: The question or topic, such as 'are bank bonuses taxed' or 'ChexSystems'.

tools.name: track_bonus
tools.description: Build a ready-made tracker entry for a bonus the person is opening or has opened: the dates that matter (last day to open, finish the requirements by, when the bonus should arrive, when the account can be closed), a link that adds the bonus to their Stack tracker on thebonusstack.com, and a calendar file with those dates. Nothing is saved on our side and no account is needed. The person taps the link to keep it in their own browser. Use it when someone says they opened an account or asks to be reminded of a deadline.

bonus_id.description: The bonus_id from find_bonuses or get_bonus.

opened_on.description: The day the person opened the account, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out when they have not opened it yet; the dates then count from today.

option.description: For a bonus with options, the option the person is doing: its offer_id from track_bonus, or its label from get_bonus.

tools.name: report_datapoint
tools.description: Send a first-hand report from the person to The Bonus Stack: which transfer counted, or did not count, as a direct deposit at a bank, or how many days a bank took to pay a bonus. Only call this after the person has told you the details and said yes to sending them. Do not include names, account numbers or balances. Reports are anonymous and are reviewed before anything is published.

kind.description: direct_deposit: which transfer counted or did not count as a direct deposit. payout_timeline: how long the bank took to pay.

bonus_id.description: The bonus_id, when the report is about a bonus we list.

bank.description: The bank's name, when there is no bonus_id.

transfer_source.description: For direct_deposit: where the money came from, such as a paycheck, Fidelity or Zelle. No account numbers.

worked.description: For direct_deposit: true when the bank counted it as a direct deposit.

account_opened_on.description: For payout_timeline: the day the account was opened, YYYY-MM-DD.

bonus_paid_on.description: For payout_timeline: the day the bonus was paid, YYYY-MM-DD.

person_agreed.description: Must be true: the person told you these details and said yes to sending them to The Bonus Stack.
